the proposed approach enables system-level simulation of realistic EEA hardware networks with high accuracy, while preserving simulation performance.

the proposed modeling extensions enable the synthesis of electric circuit- and wiring harness-aware behavioral simulations of EEA models in a system-level context.
the proposed modeling extensions allow to simulate EEA behavior in a way which is more realistic than previously possible, while preserving the advantages of system-level simulation.
